name: Outward Dak Server Script
script:
# Automatically set the sender to the user who clicks Approve (Submit)
doc.sender = frappe.session.user

name: Outward Dak Linking Files
script:
# Prevent deletion or modification of already-linked files
if not doc.is_new():
    # Fetch the version of the document currently saved in the database
    old_doc = frappe.get_doc(doc.doctype, doc.name)
    
    # Extract the file names from the old and new tables
    old_files = [row.file for row in old_doc.linked_files if row.file]
    new_files = [row.file for row in doc.linked_files if row.file]

    # Check if any previously saved file is missing from the new save attempt
    for file in old_files:
        if file not in new_files:
            frappe.throw(f"Security Violation: You cannot remove or edit the file link for '{file}' once it has been established.")
